title: Ember's Everything Asylum
description: A semi-serious mod with a little bit of something for everyone!
body:
Introducing Ember's everything asylum (formerly known as speng 'n stuff)! A mod with a little bit of something for everyone!

This mod features a large amount of custom mobs, structurs and biomes to play your way through, Each being harder than the vanilla structures allowing for a challenging and fresh experience.

Several new items have also been added, all with one or two set uses, that can be used in conjunction to pull off some great combos, allowing you to not only survive, but thrive in combat. 

Lastly, a new progression system has been added that is intended to compliment vanilla minecraft and synergize with other mods whilst not breaking anything.
